description: Header file defining constants, enums, structs, and function prototypes for WLD ZWDFS (likely a wireless DFS) functionality, including FSM states, events, context, and initialization/deinitialization functions.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_init
methods.description: Initializes the ZWDFS module with a given radio context.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the ZWDFS module for a given radio context.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_start
methods.description: Starts the ZWDFS process, with an option for direct operation.

methods.name: wld_zwdfs_stop
methods.description: Stops the ZWDFS process for a given radio context.
